outcome: Umbilical cord nucleated red blood cell (NRBC) count
cohort: 305 term neonates, divided into two groups: normal vaginal delivery (NVD) and cesarean section (C/S).
finding: The mean NRBC count within the umbilical cord of neonates born by elective C/S was less than those delivered by NVD, although this difference was not significant.
mod_finding: The mean NRBC count within the umbilical cord of neonates born by elective C/S was less than those delivered by NVD, although this difference was not significant.
